scope: Dedicated typed vocabulary, connected Practice navigation, source/card/saved-word/review links, layout/focus and bounded profile error visibility. Local synthetic guest browser data only.

acceptance.result: pass within the defined observable acceptance scope
acceptance.interpretation: Checklist acceptance, not a human satisfaction rating, learning-outcome measurement, formal accessibility certification or claim of perfect overall quality.

criteria.criterion: Practice has one discoverable starting point with distinct vocabulary, verb and grammar destinations.
criteria.evidence: Practice hub exposes three destinations; Today and five-item main navigation reach the dedicated typing area.

criteria.criterion: The dedicated vocabulary route starts a short typed round without requiring a hidden mode setting.
criteria.evidence: Fresh vocabulary round starts from the visible five-word action with recall support and no multiple-choice options.

criteria.criterion: Vocabulary themes and search make the expanded library browseable without a long unstructured wall.
criteria.evidence: 728 visible-library entries across61 themes; six topic cards initially, paged expansion, EN/IT term search, empty results and query reload.

criteria.criterion: Vocabulary, saved words, lesson cards and related grammar have clear contextual navigation and return paths.
criteria.evidence: New-theme vocabulary cards match the selected theme; Find opens the matching typing theme; saved words and grammar-only expressions return to typed rounds.

criteria.criterion: Exactly one vocabulary question is active at a time; instructions state what to type.
criteria.evidence: One active word prompt, one Italian input and explicit article/accent guidance.

criteria.criterion: Correct, wrong and hinted answers receive understandable bilingual feedback; supported work is labelled honestly.
criteria.evidence: Wrong, correct, hinted and revealed-answer paths checked; first error and support evidence retained. Accent insertion checked.

criteria.criterion: A typed draft survives reload and leaving the vocabulary area; an unrelated saved game is retained.
criteria.evidence: Typed draft and hint survive reload and pause; an unrelated Arcade round/draft remains unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Round completion gives an honest score, a clear stopping point and an obvious next action.
criteria.evidence: Controlled five-word journey yields3 independent,1 supported and1wrong; finish offers retry/next/stop and focuses its heading.

criteria.criterion: Shared review and saved word routes correctly return to the relevant vocabulary practice.
criteria.evidence: Shared scheduled review opens the correct typed word. Saved library and grammar-only words are typeable; original first attempts remain intact.

criteria.criterion: The tested EN/IT layouts have no horizontal page overflow at 320, 360, 390, 768 and 1440 CSS pixels.
criteria.evidence: 144-state EN/IT matrix across320/360/390/768/1440 portrait/desktop plus844×390 landscape; no horizontal overflow.

criteria.criterion: Short landscape layouts at 844×390 allow scrolling to all question and feedback actions without clipping.
criteria.evidence: Landscape matrix completes one-word rounds through actual answer/finish clicks; actions remain reachable by scrolling.

criteria.criterion: Primary vocabulary entry/start actions are visible or immediately discoverable on narrow portrait screens without tall decorative obstruction.
criteria.evidence: Typed start ends at y564 on320px EN/IT and y540–564 on390px; no tall decorative header obstructs entry.

criteria.criterion: Visible interactive targets in the new practice/vocabulary flow are at least 44px high, or have documented equivalent spacing.
criteria.evidence: All measured main-area controls are≥44px; targeted compact-header home/EN/IT controls are44px high.

criteria.criterion: Question, field and feedback padding remains readable; text, controls and focus outlines are not cut off by containers.
criteria.evidence: No measured text/control clipping.16px phone input text and readable padding retained. Topic/feedback gap and Next/Save separation verified.

criteria.criterion: Answer/continue focus management brings the current task into view without hiding feedback behind other elements.
criteria.evidence: Question title, feedback and finish receive expected focus; feedback/continuation can be scrolled into view. Profile local errors, including a repeated mismatch, also focus correctly in a390px-tall viewport.

criteria.criterion: Keyboard-only navigation can start, answer and advance a vocabulary round with visible focus and no trap.
criteria.evidence: Keyboard Tab/Enter starts a round, reaches its input, submits and advances; feedback receives focus and next-button focus is visible.

criteria.criterion: A reduced-height viewport approximating an open mobile keyboard preserves access to the input and check/continue actions.
criteria.evidence: 390×390 reduced-height viewport accepts typing and can scroll to Check/Finish. This approximates keyboard height, not a physical OS keyboard.

criteria.criterion: The new flow remains readable and operable at 200% content zoom/reflow without horizontal page scrolling or loss of controls.
criteria.evidence: 200% CSS zoom at1280px remains operable through lobby/answer/feedback, with no horizontal overflow or clipped measured content.

criteria.criterion: English and Italian labels, prompts and feedback remain understandable and fit the same layouts.
criteria.evidence: All matrix paths tested in EN/IT; Italian wrapping and English short Course label visually inspected.

criteria.criterion: No uncaught browser errors occur in the audited journeys; loading/navigation does not strand the learner.
criteria.evidence: No uncaught browser errors in the audited final journeys and no profile-service requests from these synthetic guest tests.

additionalCases: 390×390 initial and repeated local PIN mismatch

savedWordBank390.note: Single saved-word fixtures with different words; the dominant change is collapsing the additional catalogue and revealing six cards on demand.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Mobile brand/language and navigation occupied two or three rows before practice content.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Compact five-destination header; active typing keeps language and pause controls.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Vocabulary topic status touched the feedback card shadow.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Correct CSS specificity restores14px top spacing.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Personal word bank rendered24 extra catalogue cards immediately.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Catalogue hidden until search/browse; then six at a time.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Parent identified grammar-only saved expressions outside the728-card visible library.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Stable supplemental typed entries include grammar-word:avere:0; tested saving from grammar and answering one valid form.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Next and Save buttons touched and successful answers were repeated twice.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Eight-pixel separation and one correct-answer display.

findingsAndRepairs.finding: Initial local PIN mismatch focused correctly, but a second mismatch did not re-trigger focus because the same error state was batched.
findingsAndRepairs.repair: Local error clears on field editing; repeated mismatch focuses and scrolls to the alert.

visualInspection: Compact word bank and short-height profile error

evidence.screenshots: Ignored work/typed-vocab-ui-audit directories; no real learner or profile records

harnessNotes: Lazy sections were measured only after explicit ready selectors resolved.
A saved word is intentionally concealed until Reveal; the final test checks the cue before revealing Italian.
Catalogue counts use visible articles, excluding the collapsed saved-word list.
limitations: Chromium desktop and emulated viewport testing, not physical iPhone/Android hardware.
200% CSS zoom/reflow and reduced-height viewport approximate magnification and keyboard geometry; OS keyboard behaviors can differ.
No authentication request, account creation or production learner-record access in this audit; profile synchronization is tested separately by the parent.
The library still permits intentional vertical scrolling; the criteria concern reachable controls, unclipped content and a short path to typing, not fitting all material on one screen.
